overview_description.description: Yenta is a professional networking and relationship-building platform designed to connect individuals, businesses, and opportunities through trusted introductions and meaningful collaborations. The platform focuses on community engagement, strategic partnerships, and business growth by helping professionals expand networks, share opportunities, and build valuable long-term professional relationships across industries worldwide.
